factors.name: US small-company equity exposure through IJR
factors.definition: Long-only actual IJR fund exposure to the S&P SmallCap600Index,used as a size-family sleeve rather than a recreated academic small-minus-big portfolio.
factors.rationale: Company scale is a different economic characteristic from momentum,value,quality and low-volatility; this adds a new family to this research catalog,not a globally new anomaly.
factors.limitations: IJR is a long-only small-cap index fund,not zero-cost SMB. Index eligibility and sector exposures can mix size with other characteristics. The S&P methodology request returned403; historical screen continuity and independent alpha are not established. Tracking futures can offset cash,so no claim of a derivatives-free fund.

factors.name: Net share-reduction exposure through PKW
factors.definition: Actual PKW fund exposure to US companies meeting the NasdaqBuyBackAchievers criterion of a net reduction in outstanding shares of5%or more over the trailing12months. Fund returns are the implementation proxy,not recreated stock-level issuance scores.
factors.rationale: Net equity issuance/repurchase is a financing and capital-return characteristic,not another moving-average parameter. The paper motivates the family but is not an exact replication or a profitability guarantee.
factors.limitations: Repurchases may reflect leverage,valuation or market timing and may overlap existing quality/value exposures. The issuer/index describe current rules; a complete historical mandate archive and independent return source are not proven.
